title: Clue
description: A discoverable piece of evidence that can reveal facts.

description.description: Detailed description shown when the clue is examined.

location_id.description: Reference to the scene or location where this clue is found.

reveals_fact_ids.description: Facts that are revealed when this clue is discovered.

requires_any_tags.description: Tags where at least one must be active for this clue to appear.

requires_all_tags.description: Tags that must all be active for this clue to appear.

strength.description: How compelling this clue is for deduction scoring (1=weak, 3=strong).

missable.description: Whether this clue can be permanently missed if not collected in time.
